tea: A hot drink made by infusing the leaves of the tea plant in water.
eat: To take food into the mouth, chew it, and swallow it.
rat: A small rodent with a long tail.
tap: To strike lightly, or a device that controls the flow of liquid from a pipe.
seat: A thing made or used for sitting on.
stone: A hard, naturally occurring piece of rock.
tone: A sound or the quality of a sound.
son: A male child in relation to a parent.
not: Used to express negation or denial.
ten: The number equivalent to the product of five and two; 10.
toe: One of the digits of the foot.
tan: A yellowish-brown color; to brown the skin in the sun; to convert hide into leather.
car: A road vehicle designed to carry passengers.
art: The expression of human creative skill and imagination.
rate: A measure, quantity, or frequency; to assign a value or rank.
care: Serious attention or consideration; to feel concern or interest.
tear: A drop of clear salty liquid from the eye; to pull something apart.
race: A competition of speed; a group of people with shared characteristics.
acre: A unit of land area equal to 4,840 square yards.
plate: A flat dish from which food is eaten or served.
late: Doing something or occurring after the expected time.
tale: A fictitious or true narrative or story.
east: The direction where the sun rises.
set: To put something in a particular place or position; a group of similar things.
net: An open-meshed fabric; the amount remaining after deductions.
pet: A domestic or tamed animal kept for companionship.
pat: To touch quickly and gently with the flat of the hand.
ape: A large primate that lacks a tail; to imitate.
age: The length of time that a person or thing has existed.
are: Present plural form of the verb be.
ear: The organ of hearing and balance in humans and animals.
era: A long and distinct period of history.
rag: A piece of old cloth, especially one torn from a larger piece.
gear: Equipment or apparatus; a toothed wheel that engages with another.
sea: The expanse of salt water that covers most of the earth's surface.
last: Coming after all others in time or order; to continue.
her: Used as the object of a verb or preposition to refer to a female person.
the: Denoting one or more people or things already mentioned or known.
here: In, at, or to this place or position.
tree: A woody perennial plant typically with a single trunk.
there: In, at, or to that place or position.
den: A wild animal's lair or habitation.
due: Expected at or planned for a certain time; owed as a debt.
end: A final part of something; to bring or come to a finish.
red: Of a color at the end of the spectrum next to orange and opposite violet.
run: To move at a speed faster than a walk.
